name: Resend "Email for Developers" OG social card by resend.com
description: A 1200×630 social card on a near-black canvas with faint diagonal light streaks rising from the lower corners. The composition is one centered column: a rounded app-icon tile, an oversized high-contrast serif headline with a subtle silver-to-white fade, and a dark code-editor mockup that bleeds off the bottom edge to imply more content below. It stays strictly monochrome — white keywords and muted gray syntax on charcoal panels with hairline borders — so the serif headline carries all the visual weight.
